boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Commonwealth Avenue, Beacon Street, Chestnut Hill Avenue, Washington Street, and nearby Brighton corridors—each with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Circle the Reservoir
cards.subtitle: Chestnut Hill Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Chestnut Hill Avenue and follow the 1.5-mile paved reservoir loop for a walk, run, or bike ride before sunset.
cards.short_summary: A paved waterside circuit immediately east of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Massachusetts DCR identifies a 1.5-mile paved trail around Chestnut Hill Reservoir for walking, jogging, and biking.
cards.access_notes: The reservation is open from sunrise to sunset; street parking is available.

cards.title: See Three-Story Steam Pumps
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk through the Great Engines Hall and examine the three preserved steam-driven pumps that once moved Boston’s drinking water.
cards.short_summary: Industrial-scale engineering inside a historic pumping station.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that its Great Engines Hall preserves three original coal-powered, steam-driven water pumps more than three stories tall.
cards.access_notes: Consult the museum’s official visit page before departure for the current public schedule.

cards.title: Choose a Sicilian Slice
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street corridor at Cleveland Circle
cards.notes: Stop at the Beacon Street counter and choose from the documented pizza and sub menu; bring a payment method accepted that day.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Cleveland Circle pizza counter.
cards.evidence_claim: Pino's official site places the restaurant at 1920-A Beacon Street and documents pizza, Sicilian pizza, subs, delivery, and catering.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Sunday–Thursday 10 a.m.–11 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–midnight; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Deli Breakfast Stop
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street corridor at Cleveland Circle
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s breakfast, burger, and sandwich menu to plan a casual counter-service meal at Cleveland Circle.
cards.short_summary: Breakfast and sandwiches one storefront from Pino’s.
cards.evidence_claim: Eagle's Deli identifies its address as 1918 Beacon Street in Cleveland Circle and says it serves breakfast, burgers, sandwiches, and more.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; verify current service before departure.

cards.title: Restock Groceries in One Trip
cards.subtitle: Beacon Street corridor
cards.notes: Make a grocery list before heading down Beacon Street; the official location page confirms delivery, pickup, and SNAP EBT services.
cards.short_summary: A full grocery stop east of Cleveland Circle.
cards.evidence_claim: Star Market's official locator lists a store at 1717 Beacon Street with grocery delivery, same-day delivery, DriveUp & Go, and SNAP EBT Online.
cards.source_title: Star Market Locations in Brookline, MA
cards.access_notes: The official locator lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Reset with Coffee and Food
cards.subtitle: Chestnut Hill Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Brighton menu to order espresso, fresh food, or a functional beverage at the Chestnut Hill Avenue café.
cards.short_summary: A daytime café between campus and Cleveland Circle.
cards.evidence_claim: Fuel America's official ordering page identifies its Brighton café at 152 Chestnut Hill Avenue and describes espresso, fresh food, and functional beverages.
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page lists 6:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; check the live page for current availability.

cards.title: Order a Greek Rice Bowl
cards.subtitle: Chestnut Hill Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue north on Chestnut Hill Avenue and use the official menu to select a gyro, souvlaki, falafel, or rice bowl.
cards.short_summary: Greek plates and bowls farther up the same corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Gyro Theory's official site places it at 356B Chestnut Hill Avenue and lists gyros, souvlaki, falafel, rice bowls, spreads, and desserts.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Monday–Sunday 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; verify the current schedule before a late visit.

cards.title: Read Brighton’s Landscape History
cards.subtitle: Commonwealth Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter during posted gate hours and observe how winding roads, plantings, and rocky terrain shaped this historic rural cemetery.
cards.short_summary: A documented nineteenth-century landscape beside BC.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston.gov identifies Evergreen Cemetery at 2060 Commonwealth Avenue as a 19.66-acre historic cemetery, consecrated in 1850 and adjacent to Boston College.
cards.access_notes: Gates are listed as 7:30 a.m.–7 p.m. April–September and 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m. October–March.

cards.title: Use Wi-Fi, Computers, and Scanners
cards.subtitle: Academy Hill Road corridor near Brighton Center
cards.notes: Bring study materials and use the branch’s documented Wi-Fi, computers, printing, scanning, or reservable community spaces.
cards.short_summary: Public study infrastructure near Washington Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Public Library lists Wi-Fi, computers, printing, scanning, laptops, outdoor space, and reservable community space at its Brighton Branch.
cards.access_notes: The branch publishes current daily hours and closures on its official location page; check them before leaving.

cards.title: Connect with Community Programs
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor in Brighton Center
cards.notes: Contact the center before visiting to ask about current tutoring, adult English classes, volunteering, or community programming.
cards.short_summary: BC’s community-facing base in Brighton Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston College places its Neighborhood Center at 480 Washington Street and documents adult English classes, school-age tutoring, and student volunteer opportunities.
cards.access_notes: The contact page lists academic-year hours Monday–Friday noon–5 p.m., with shorter Friday hours in summer; contact ahead.
